fullContentHtml:
JIPMER Group A Non-Faculty Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER) has released the Notification for the recruitment of JIPMER Exam 2026. This recruitment has been issued for 34 posts. Applications for the JIPMER Group A Non-Faculty Recruitment 2026 has Started from 12 June 2026, & Candidate can apply till 01 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for JIPMER Group A Non-Faculty Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 12 June 2026
  • Last Date : 01 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 01 July 2026
  • Exam Date : 15 July 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam
  • Result Available : Available Soon

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1500/-
  • SC, ST, : Rs. 1200/-
  • PH Candidate : Rs. 0/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

Important Links

  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is JIPMER Group A Non-Faculty Online Form 2026?

JIPMER Group A Non-Faculty Online Form 2026 is an official government examination / recruitment update. Full details and direct links are provided on this page.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
